row.body: The house key is tied to a route map, and the sale card says the rooms were clear before the road inspection was finished.
row.title: A property near the route

sidecar.gloss: A house is recorded clear before its road check ends.
sidecar.rival_reading: A property could be cleared for sale while a nearby route was inspected; the map does not prove anyone was stranded.

row.body: three pickup dots mark the antibiotics and folded road map. two were scratched away without wear around them.

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
